channel.title: Crypto Daybook
channel.description: Crypto Daybook reports daily crypto news: market moves, Bitcoin and Ethereum updates, exchange and protocol developments, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: EVM Testnet Faucet: How Tokens Reach Your Wallet
item.description: An EVM testnet faucet sends test tokens to your wallet address, giving you funds to try apps and pay gas on that test network without using mainnet assets.

item.title: Should I speed up a pending bridge deposit or wait?
item.description: Speed up or wait on a pending bridge deposit transaction? Raise the fee only while the source transaction is pending and underpriced; once confirmed, wait.

item.title: Chainflip says $12 million stolen from vaults, offers 10% bounty
item.description: Chainflip says an attacker took bitcoin, ether and stablecoins worth about $12 million and has set a deadline to return most of the funds.

item.title: Chainflip halts swaps after $4.86M Ethereum vault drain
item.description: Chainflip halted swaps after $4.86 million left its Ethereum vault, and FLIP fell more than 30%; the team is investigating and has offered a return bounty.

item.title: Injective Approves Veyra Upgrade, Targets Nov. 24
item.description: Injective’s Veyra upgrade won governance approval and targets a Nov. 24 chain halt, bringing cross-chain transfers and institutional trading tools closer to mainnet.

item.title: Liquidation Risk for a Beginner Borrower: How It Works
item.description: How to explain liquidation risk to a beginner borrower: collateral backs debt; below 1, health factor can trigger repayment and a bonus taken from collateral.

item.title: US gets court approval to seize $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized it to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance, as recovery efforts continue.

item.title: Solana Token Supply Growth Can Dilute Your Share
item.description: Why did my token supply increase after I bought it? Usually, the mint authority created new tokens; Token-2022 can also raise the displayed amount while raw supply stays flat.

item.title: Deribit reopens after second trading halt on Nov. 20
item.description: Deribit reopened trading at 21:30 UTC on Nov. 20 after a second halt, then lifted temporary order caps across all instruments by 22:31 UTC that evening.

item.title: Single-Token Liquidity on SyncSwap: What the Pool Swap Changes
item.description: Adding liquidity with one token on SyncSwap? Check pool depth, pool type, quoted LP tokens, slippage on minted LP tokens, and your exposure to both assets.

item.title: Threshold Encryption and TEE Mempool Privacy
item.description: Threshold encryption vs TEE for encrypted mempools: keyholders decrypt after ordering, while trusted hardware decrypts early enough for simulation and filtering.

item.title: WETH After a Swap: Your ETH Is Still Worth 1:1
item.description: Received WETH instead of ETH after a swap? WETH is ETH wrapped as a token and usually keeps its 1:1 value; unwrap it on Ethereum or an L2 to get native ETH.

item.title: How to Move USDC from Ethereum to Monad for Less
item.description: Cheapest way to move USDC from Ethereum to Monad: compare native USDC and permit routes, then send at a low Ethereum base fee to cut total cost.

item.title: US wins authority to seize or restrain $1.2B in Binance funds
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion tied to the Binance hack, part of $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: Injective’s Veyra upgrade passes ahead of Nov. 24 activation
item.description: Injective’s Veyra upgrade passed governance, clearing a path to a Nov. 24 mainnet halt and new cross-chain and institutional trading tools for builders.

item.title: Mint Authority and Who Can Expand a Token’s Supply
item.description: What is mint authority on a token? It lets one address create supply; judge the holder’s control, program rules and upgrade authority before you buy.

item.title: How to use teleBTC on Polygon DeFi with a wallet ready
item.description: How to use teleBTC on Polygon DeFi: connect your wallet, find an app that supports it, then swap, supply to a pool or lend where available, with Polygon gas.

item.title: How to Sign a DeFi Transaction With a Hardware Wallet Safely
item.description: How to sign a DeFi transaction with a hardware wallet: connect a compatible app, compare the request with the device screen, approve each prompt, then track its hash.

item.title: USDT on TRC-20 or ERC-20? Match the DEX pair
item.description: USDT TRC-20 vs ERC-20 for DEX trading: use the chain where your token pair has a pool, then weigh TRON resources against Ethereum gas before you withdraw.

item.title: Eigen Layer Slashing: From AVS Fault to Restaker Shares
item.description: How does eigen layer slashing work? An AVS can slash only stake its operator allocated to its Operator Set, reducing delegators’ withdrawable shares proportionally.
